title: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Health — Simple Present
titleVi: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Sức khỏe — Thì Hiện Tại Đơn

speakingCueCard.prompt: Describe a healthy habit that you think everyone should have.
bulletPoints: How common it is in your country
Why some people find it difficult to maintain

questionPrompt: Read the speaking response below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
questionPromptVi: Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây. Chọn mỗi lỗi ngữ pháp bạn phát hiện bằng cách bôi đen. Bạn có thể gõ bản sửa đúng vào ô hiện ra.
passageText: In my opinion, drinking enough water every day is one of the simplest yet most important habits that a person can develop. Most doctors agree that proper hydration improve concentration, boost energy levels, and support the immune system. Unfortunately, a large number of people in my country does not drink enough water because they prefer sugary drinks instead. My grandmother, for instance, always remind me to carry a water bottle wherever I go, and I appreciate her concern. I strongly feel that this habit deserve more attention in public health campaigns, because many illnesses come from basic neglect of the body. If more schools teach children about hydration, I believe the overall health of our society would improve significantly.

errors.explanationVi: 'Hydration' là danh từ không đếm được số ít — dùng 'improves', không phải 'improve'.

errors.errorText: a large number of people in my country does not drink
errors.correctText: a large number of people in my country do not drink
acceptedAnswers: a large number of people in my country do not drink
a large number of people in my country don't drink
errors.explanation: 'A large number of people' takes a plural verb because the focus is on 'people'. Use 'do not drink', not 'does not drink'.
errors.explanationVi: 'A large number of people' dùng động từ số nhiều vì trọng tâm là 'people'. Dùng 'do not drink', không phải 'does not drink'.
'This habit' là số ít — dùng 'deserves', không phải 'deserve'.

falseAlarmZones.hint: 'Most doctors agree' is correct — 'doctors' is plural, so the base form 'agree' is used.

collocations.exampleSentence: Proper hydration is essential during hot weather to avoid heatstroke.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Proper hydration' — không dùng 'correct hydration' hay 'good hydration' (ít tự nhiên)

collocations.exampleSentence: A short nap after lunch can boost energy levels for the rest of the day.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Boost' dùng trực tiếp — không dùng 'boost up' (thừa)

collocations.translation: chiến dịch y tế công cộng
collocations.exampleSentence: Public health campaigns about smoking have saved millions of lives.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Public health campaign' — không dùng 'health public campaign' (sai thứ tự tính từ)

collocations.translation: sự thiếu chăm sóc cơ thể
collocations.exampleSentence: Many health problems arise from simple neglect of the body over long periods.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Neglect of + danh từ' — không dùng 'neglect to the body'

collocations.sourceInPassage: carry a water bottle wherever I go
collocations.exampleSentence: My doctor told me to carry a water bottle everywhere to stay hydrated.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Carry a water bottle' — không dùng 'bring a water bottle' khi nói về mang theo trên người

generationMatrix.discourseSituation: A learner giving strong opinions about why drinking water is an essential habit
